newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa may consolidate gains, push higher.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa may consolidate gains, push higher.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures have scope to rise further and build on the gains amassed after the breakaway surge seen earlier this month, technical analysts said on Monday.
"I think the London chart looks fairly promising," said Adrian Haylor, a technical analyst at Sucden.
"It looks like it's consolidating these gains and there might be scope for another push higher."
London's September contract left a hefty breakaway gap of 13 stg earlier this month when it finally motored through the 1,100 stg a tonne barrier in a volatile session.

Since then its price action had remained relatively bullish, although the contract had hit its head at 1,150 stg in three consecutive sessions last week. That was despite a rally to a fresh life-high of 1,162 on Tuesday.
"While this picture holds it probably looks friendly until, or if, 1,100 were to break," Haylor said.
Nearby support was pegged at 1,130, the recent area of session lows, followed by 1,100.
Traders called the London market to open around two stg lower than Friday's close.
Fundamentally, second-quarter European grind data were due this week and were expected to be mixed.
Arrivals of mid-crop cocoa from Ivory Coast and Nigeria should also start hitting the markets from this week. Although the crops were slightly delayed, the quality was said to be good.
